name: 50211 · Norwalk, IA
findings: ZIP 50211 (Norwalk) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50211 (Norwalk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 50211 (Norwalk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).
